adopted_unproven_and_deferred_scope_text:
The finite caps are conjunctive ceilings. Sixty-four admissions,128KiB state,160KiB requests and8MiB prefix are not a promise that all maxima, every large shape or every listed count can be reached together. Refusal below an individual maximum is part of this proof; acknowledged prefixes must remain readable and retryable. The fixed fixture vocabulary and minimum synthetic cases do not establish city-scale organizations or an indefinite campaign.

The authored roots contain eight native actor identities, six information participants, four organizations and four containers. There is no arbitrary actor/organization creation or policy-loading API. Authored time targets are0–1,000,000; the wider JSON integer range does not expand that operation grammar. Count/byte boundary controls use smaller immutable profiles where the default maximum cannot be reached under other ceilings. Such tests establish the selected guard/refusal behavior; they do not establish simultaneous or default maximum capacity.

The trusted controller selects the actor and historical cutoff; cutoff is a native admission ordinal omitted from the actor projection. A public actor-controlled cutoff, identity/authentication or network protocol is not provided by this private reference API.

The work model counts defined byte passes, semantic node/edge/record visits, predicate terms and full-key sort bounds. Measurements are separate. Neither the counter nor conservative memory/workspace reservation is a Python/OS sandbox or CPU-instruction guarantee. The proof does not certify power/device/whole-volume loss, hostile plugins, formal timing isolation, distributed execution, arbitrary binary/backends or production reliability.

Sincerity, intent and incident actuality in A–L are synthetic fixture stipulations. The proof preserves claims and acquired evidence; it does not infer psychology, automatically revise stance, resolve normative truth or implement police/tax/insurance/gang rules. Full KeyWrapping UI/composer and Player scratchpad/stance authoring, general dialogue/planning/memory, playable content, production integration, old-world compatibility, migration/compaction, accepted-package remediation, Unity/Stage13 and remote Git actions remain deferred.
